name: print-social-indigo-and-peach-conference-social-kit-large
title: Indigo, peach and violet conference kit with organic blob patterns and pill agenda cards
whatItIs: Six square assets on peach: an agenda list of peach pills with white icons on indigo, a website preview on a lilac field, a programme leaflet, a 'Don't miss out!' progress-bar post over a syllabics pattern, a speaker-photo split, and a save-the-date over a peach-violet blob pattern.
whatItMeans: Warm and respectful; organic patterns and syllabics give cultural identity.
techniques: Use organic blob patterns as brand texture.
Agenda items as peach pills with icons.
Use a progress bar for countdown.
Show website, print and social together.

vocabulary.definition: A pattern of flowing organic shapes.
A capsule with an event item.
A bar showing time or seats left.
A set of assets for one event.
